title: Senior Product Engineer (Incident Response, remote)
description: (Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3) Help turn Checkly's incident response, on-call and status pages from a young product that customers already pay for into a core part of our platform. In 2027 agents will be on call and we want to be ready for that. You'll shape what we build in 2027, build it with AI coding agents, and talk directly to the teams who use it in the middle of an incident. The best engineering teams don't wait for users to tell them something's broken. They build resilient, reliable systems to catch it first: in the pull request, in staging, or production at 3am, before a single customer notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. Checkly gives developers, SRE teams and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: testing and synthetic monitoring defined as code, built on OpenTelemetry and Playwright. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place. This role is about the post-mortem end of that line. We've built incident management, status pages and on-call into Checkly, and it's already bringing in revenue. Now we want to drive it strategically. Figure out together with us how to evolve incident management with clear signals and with agents being on call. Thousands of teams, from AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering organizations like LinkedIn, Citi and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel. Our stack is AI (Claude, Codex, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Go, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We don't filter on programming language. If you ship full-stack with AI, you'll pick ours up. We ship to prod all day, every day, practice Agile (not scrum), keep meetings low and take pride in good documentation and good looking products. What you'll do Shape a product from early stage to strategic. You'll be involved early in how we build incident response out as a platform, technically and on the product side. That means a lot of ownership, influence and visibility. Build the foundation first. Incident management, status pages, on-call, and tight integration with the rest of Checkly. For at least the first six months this is solid product engineering. AI-assisted incident response comes once the foundation is in place. Build and ship with AI. Coding agents are how you work: exploring solutions, scaffolding, refactoring, testing and debugging. Talk to the people on call. You'll be directly involved in customer conversations. You'll learn how responders work under pressure and turn that into what we build next. Find the right problems to solve. In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements. Own your work end to end. From the first idea to rollout to how it behaves in production. You'll join the on-call and support rotations like everyone else. What you should have You've built incident management, on-call, alerting or status page products before. You know what responders need from a tool when something breaks at 3am. You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users. You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them. You can drive a product area, not just pick up tickets. You make decisions without perfect information, and you ask for input when it counts. You have opinions about what we should build and why, and you change your mind when someone makes a better case. You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck. You share work early. Drafts, rough MVPs and half-finished docs go out for feedback before they’re polished. In an async team, that’s how good ideas get better fast. FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without waiting for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, team meetups or conferences. What you will hate about us We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two. We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine. We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here. We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else. We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic. Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up. How we build with AI Don’t take our word for it. Here’s what that looks like in practice, written by the team: Checkly and the agentic software layer : Hannes on why the CLI is how agents use software, including running monitoring and incidents. Your software factory stops at deploy : Stefan on what happens after deploy, when a failing check should kick off the fix. We let AI agents rewrite a 92M-message-a-day service in Go : Eddie on porting a core service with an agent, and zero incidents. Why I built my own AI agent orchestration tool : Immanuel on running 10 to 20 coding agents at once. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location. title: Werkstudent Customer Retention
description: Crisp is een van de snelst groeiende scale-ups in Europa. Klantretentie speelt hierbij een belangrijke rol. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar een allround stagiair die ons kan ondersteunen bij het continue activeren van onze klanten. Bij Crisp bevind je je in een uitdagende omgeving met veel kansen om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wat je gaat doen Als Werkstudent Customer Retention krijg je een uniek inzicht in de wereld van consumentenpsychologie en de rol van marketing in consumentengedrag. Je ondersteunt de campagne & promotion specialists in ons Retentie-team bij een breed scala aan marketingtools, van promoties en prijzen tot heractivatie- en nieuwsbriefcampagnes. Je neemt volledig deel aan het Retentie-team en werkt nauw samen met onze Campaign- & Promotion Specialists, en onze Head of Retention. Enkele voorbeelden van wat je gaat doen: End-to-end uitvoering van e-mailcampagnes; van het aanvragen en selecteren van de juiste inhoud tot het instellen en uitvoeren van de technische details en het analyseren van de resultaten. 360-graden-uitvoering van onze promotiecampagnes, inclusief het selecteren van de optimale promotieproducten, het afstemmen met het forecast- en buyerteam, het creëren en verzenden van communicatie via meerdere kanalen, en het analyseren van resultaten. Het opzetten van A/B-testen om de effectiviteit van onze content en promoties te verbeteren. Dit ben jij Je bent parttime (16-24 uur per week) beschikbaar. Je bent in de mogelijkheid om doordeweeks overdag bij ons op kantoor te werken. Je hebt een passie voor consumentenpsychologie, marketing en promotie. Je hebt ervaring in het coördineren van projecten. Je hebt oog voor detail en je bent resultaatgericht. Je hebt (net als de rest van ons team) een passie voor duurzaam en lekker eten. Je spreekt en schrijft uitstekend Nederlands. Wat wij bieden De kans om je stempel te drukken op ons voedselsysteem met jouw inzet en ervaring en echte veranderingen teweeg te brengen. Enthousiaste en ondernemende collega's om mee te werken en van te leren. Een kijkje achter de schermen bij een van de snelst groeiende bedrijven op de Europese markt. Tijd om je collega's te leren kennen tijdens sport, evenementen en proeverijen. Een kantoor op Amsterdam Sloterdijk waar je kunt genieten van een goede lunch en een drankje. En... een flinke korting op je Crisp-boodschappen, want je wilt natuurlijk ook thuis goed eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. title: Technical Support Engineer, Spanish Bilingual (6 Month Contract, Remote)
description: Brain Corp is a San Diego, California, USA-based AI company creating transformative core technology for the robotics industry. Our purpose is to create autonomous technology that helps the real world work better. Brain's robotic and AI solutions help retailers ensure that the right product is on the right shelf at the right price, in a clean environment. Through the BrainOS® Robotics Platform, which powers the largest global fleet of the Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) in operation in commercial public spaces, Brain Corp delivers insightful and efficient automated solutions in both commercial floor cleaning and inventory management, empowering organizations and their employees to achieve more. Brain Corp currently powers more than 50,000 AMRs, representing the largest fleet of its kind in the world. Brain Corp is funded by the SoftBank Vision Fund, Clearbridge, and Qualcomm Ventures. Named a top workplace by the San Diego Union Tribune and USA today in 2025, we make life-changing impacts through innovation, helping workers globally unlock their abilities in orchestration with intelligent machines. Position Summary: As a member of our Technical Support Team, the bilingual Technical Support Engineer plays a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless operation of robots deployed in real-world applications. Following the Tech Support team’s discipline and process, this involves leveraging data collected from the robots and accessible through cloud platforms to analyze events impacting customer operations, identify potential errors, and deliver effective solutions across both software and hardware domains. Utilizing this individual’s bilingual skills, this position also serves as the primary liaison between our Spanish-speaking customers and our engineering teams, advocating for customer needs and using feedback to drive ongoing product enhancements and innovations. Essential Job Functions: Translate and interpret between Spanish-speaking customers, field partners, and internal English-speaking teams so that issue reports, technical guidance, and resolutions are communicated accurately and quickly Responsible for providing support for Brain Corp’s fleet of robots providing step-by-step technical solutions for common issues such as sensor malfunctions, issues in real-time Proactively monitor deployed fleet of robots remotely using internal tools to identify and solve issues effectively Conduct independent technical troubleshooting on customer-reported issues and implement effective resolutions Understand the needs of our OEMs and resolve any issues they encounter in a timely and efficient manner, leading internal or external customer-related initiatives as needed Communicate effectively with customers, and actively manage and coordinate transactional activities with third party service providers, with the goal of minimizing disruptions to customers’ operation Participate in the quality resolution process, initiating from customer-reported symptoms, progressing through troubleshooting cycles to identify root causes effectively Develop and expand comprehensive expertise in Brain Corp’s robotic systems, encompassing hardware, software, navigation kits, sub-system and cloud infrastructure; utilize this knowledge to effectively troubleshoot and resolve issues as they arise Assist with Shelf Scan projects as requested Work with internal teams to improve tools and processes Log tickets and track the progress of cases in a ticketing system with clear, accurate and concise documentation Education and/or Work Experience Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or STEM-related field, or equivalent experience 3-5 years of experience in a technical role or customer service involving direct interaction with customers Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Other Characteristics: Technical Spanish fluency: Fluent in written and spoken Spanish and English, including the ability to explain technical topics such as robot hardware, sensors, software, and troubleshooting steps clearly and accurately in both languages Familiarity with Linux Experience creating data dashboards using tools as Tableau, Grafana, PowerBI, etc, integrating data from various data sources such as SQL and Big Query Experience using Confluence and a Ticketing system such as Jira, ServiceNow or Salesforce Service Cloud Experience with SQL, Big Query, data dashboards (Tableau, Grafana, or PowerBI), ticketing systems (Jira, Service Cloud), Confluence Possess the ability to understand complex software infrastructure and architecture Exhibit strong analytical skills and the capacity to approach complex issues with a logical and methodical mindset Demonstrate strong technical troubleshooting skills in resolving software and hardware issues Demonstrate excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively articulate and communicate complicated technical issues to customers, peers and engineering teams Collaborate effectively within small, cohesive teams to achieve common goals Things that make a difference: Ability to travel if the need arises Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. title: Senior Deal Desk Operations Manager
description: About Keyfactor Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor! Job Summary: The Senior Deal Desk Operations Manager is an advanced individual contributor responsible for independently managing complex Deal Desk transactions across new business, expansion, and renewal activities, ensuring accurate execution throughout the quote-to-close process. The role applies advanced functional knowledge to review commercial deal structures, interpret contractual terms, validate transaction and subscription data, and resolve complex operational issues involving quoting, booking, billing, and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR). Working closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Salesforce administrators, the position supports the resolution of transactional exceptions and maintains operational accuracy across commercial processes and systems. The role also serves as a knowledgeable resource for Deal Desk processes, provides guidance to colleagues, identifies recurring operational challenges, and recommends improvements to established workflows. The position contributes to the implementation of approved process and system enhancements while operating independently within established policies, procedures, and decision-making authority. Job Responsibilities: Deal Desk Transaction Execution: Independently manage and coordinate complex Deal Desk transactions across new business, expansions, and renewals, including quote preparation, validation, approval coordination, booking, and post-booking activities, ensuring accurate and timely execution in accordance with established processes. Commercial Deal Review: Review and validate complex commercial deal structures, including multi-year agreements, co-terming, contract amendments, non-standard pricing, and subscription modifications, identifying inconsistencies and ensuring alignment with approved commercial terms and internal policies. Contract Interpretation and Operational Accuracy: Interpret contractual terms and translate approved commercial agreements into accurate quoting, booking, billing, ARR, renewal, and subscription records, collaborating with relevant stakeholders to resolve discrepancies. Salesforce and Data Integrity: Maintain and validate the accuracy and completeness of Salesforce opportunities, quotes, contracts, subscriptions, account hierarchies, ARR information, and supporting documentation, identifying and correcting data inconsistencies within established procedures. Salesforce and Data Integrity: Maintain and validate the accuracy and completeness of Salesforce opportunities, quotes, contracts, subscriptions, account hierarchies, ARR information, and supporting documentation, identifying and correcting data inconsistencies within established procedures. Cross-Functional Deal Coordination: Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to address deal exceptions, clarify operational requirements, facilitate transaction approvals, and ensure accurate execution of commercial agreements. Finance and Downstream Operational Coordination: Coordinate with Finance and other relevant teams to investigate and resolve recurring booking, ARR recognition and re-recognition, subscription, and downstream operational discrepancies, escalating systemic issues or decisions outside established authority as appropriate. Process Improvement Support: Identify recurring operational issues, process gaps, and opportunities to improve transaction accuracy and efficiency; recommend practical solutions and contribute to the implementation of approved improvements within established Deal Desk processes. Systems and Workflow Enhancement Support: Collaborate with Salesforce administrators and Revenue Operations to document operational requirements, participate in testing, validate system changes, and support the implementation of approved enhancements to Deal Desk workflows and related systems. Subject-Matter Guidance and Knowledge Sharing: Provide functional guidance to colleagues on complex deal structures, contractual scenarios, Salesforce processes, and operational requirements; maintain process documentation, share best practices, and support consistent application of established Deal Desk procedures. Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Typically 4–6 years of related professional experience in Deal Desk Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Order Management, or a comparable commercial operations function, consistent with the IC4 experience benchmark. Solid knowledge of quote-to-close processes, including opportunity management, quoting, contracting, order booking, and post-booking operational activities. Experience reviewing complex commercial transactions, including multi-year agreements, renewals, expansions, co-terming, contract amendments, and non-standard commercial terms. Working knowledge of subscription-based business models, ARR concepts, subscription lifecycle management, and related billing and booking processes. Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM, including opportunities, quotes, contracts, subscriptions, and related commercial data. Experience collaborating with Finance, Sales, Legal, Customer Success, and other operational stakeholders. Familiarity with CRM enhancements, process documentation, user acceptance testing, or workflow improvement activities. Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate complex commercial and operational issues. Strong attention to detail and accuracy when reviewing contractual terms, transactional records, subscription data, and ARR calculations. Proficiency in Salesforce and Microsoft Excel or comparable data analysis tools. Strong organizational and prioritization skills to manage multiple transactions and competing deadlines. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex operational matters to cross-functional stakeholders. Strong stakeholder coordination and collaboration skills. Ability to document operational processes, identify recurring issues, and recommend practical improvements. Ability to independently execute specialized and complex Deal Desk activities within established policies and procedures. Ability to interpret commercial agreements and translate contractual terms into accurate operational records. Ability to identify discrepancies, assess operational implications, and determine appropriate corrective actions within defined authority. Ability to recognize process inefficiencies, recommend improvements, and contribute to implementation activities under appropriate management direction. Credit risk framework and pricing Maintain the first-line Credit Risk / Credit Underwriting framework and supporting operating procedures. Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, consistency and control of the credit process. title: Senior Product Manager, Customer Experience
description: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Customer Experience (CX) team and help shape how home service businesses get support, hear from us, and succeed with Jobber . We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, electricians, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber, they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn't like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That's why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want! Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail's Canada's Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada's Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. We've come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we've just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers . The team Customer Experience (CX) 's mission is to set service providers up to succeed with Jobber every day. We own our in-product support experience, sign-up and onboarding, and cart and checkout, along with the customer profiles, industry success playbooks, and AI-powered tools that help each provider reach the next growth milestone that matters to their business. CX also owns customer trust at Jobber: how we earn it, and how we measure it. CX is a horizontal team, which means our work touches every part of Jobber. We partner with product, design and engineering teams throughout the company, and with leaders across Customer Success, Support, Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations, to set goals and track progress. The role Reporting to the VP, Customer Experience Innovation, you will lead product strategy and execution for key areas of the CX roadmap. You'll work alongside our CX leadership team across Product, Engineering, and Design to set direction, define what success looks like, and deliver results. This is an opportunity to take on some of Jobber's most important customer problems, with a clear mandate to rethink how we support, coach, and communicate with our customers using AI. Your work will span our customer channels and the AI agents behind them, proactive coaching built on customer profiles and industry success playbooks, and omni-channel communications in and out of the product. The areas you own may shift as our priorities do. As a Senior Product Manager, Customer Experience, you will: Lead end-to-end product development for key CX initiatives, from discovery and strategy through to delivery. Get close to our customers , talking with service providers and our Marketing, Support, and Success teams to understand their pain points first-hand. Use data and customer insights to drive decisions , identifying the biggest opportunities, sizing their impact, and measuring results. Think in systems , connecting support, communications, and the in-product experience so they work as one for our customers. Work horizontally across Jobber , partnering with other product teams and with Customer Success, Support, Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations to prioritize key strategies and initiatives. Shape how AI supports our customers and teams , including when to automate, when to bring in a person, and how we measure quality and trust. Define and execute the roadmap , balancing short-term wins with long-term innovation. Own the outcomes for your area , with accountability for how easily customers get help, how quickly their issues are resolved, and how successful they are with Jobber, and report on progress to senior leadership. To be successful, you should have: Proven experience as a Senior Product Manager in a SaaS or technology company, with a track record of driving measurable outcomes. Experience owning customer-facing products in areas like onboarding, adoption, retention, or customer support. We care more about how you've improved customers' lives than which industry you've worked in. A deep curiosity about customers. You talk to customers regularly, dig into their pain points, and bring what you learn back to your team. Strong systems thinking , with the ability to connect customer needs, product experiences, and business outcomes, and to explain complex systems simply. Strong analytical skills. You're comfortable getting into the data yourself, and you know how to turn what you find into a clear recommendation. A track record of leading through influence , ideally on a horizontal or platform team, aligning product teams and business stakeholders around shared goals. A strong ability to translate across technical and non-technical domains. You're comfortable going deep on trade-offs with engineers and bringing business stakeholders along. A commitment to earning customer trust , building experiences that serve customers for the long term. Exceptional communication, strategic thinking, and execution skills , with the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and motivate teams around bold goals. Bonus points (but not a deal-breaker) if you have: Experience building chat, messaging, or omni-channel communication products. Experience building AI or LLM-powered products, such as AI agents, assistants, or help desk platforms (for example, Fin or Zendesk AI). Experience working closely with Customer Success, Marketing, or Support organizations. Experience in vertical SaaS or serving small businesses. Location We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person. We prefer candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo . We're also open to exceptional candidates working remotely in Canada. Compensation At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $120,120, a midpoint of $171,600, and a maximum salary of $223,080, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling. We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills and experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. You'll also have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development. We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process! What you can expect from Jobber: A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options. A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential. A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet. To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers. We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process. A bit more about us: Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

Lead a global client success team of around 15 people , with 3–6 direct reports Harmonise our customer success function globally : one model, one set of standards and one way of measuring outcomes , applied with judgement to each market. Own the post-sale experience for customers across Singu and its group businesses. Shape how the customer success organisation is structured , whether by geography, industry or contract size, and the role of country leads within it. Lead and develop customer success leaders and teams across markets, including country and segment leads who also manage their own customer portfolios. Establish and monitor consistent global KPIs for retention, expansion, customer health and satisfaction. Manage relationships with strategic and high-value customers and act as the escalation point for complex situations. Partner with Sales on smooth handovers and joint account planning for growth. Work with Product and Delivery to prioritise customer feedback and influence roadmap decisions . Design and implement scalable processes, playbooks and tooling . Report to the CCO and senior leadership on customer health, revenue risks and growth opportunities across all markets. Fewer surprise cancellations , with at-risk accounts identified early and supported by an owned recovery plan. Adoption. Deeper and broader use of the products customers have bought, measured consistently across markets and segments. Time to value. Shorter time from contract signature to the outcome the customer bought the solution for. Customer advocacy. Improving NPS and CSAT , and a growing base of customers willing to act as references and champions . Key measures. Gross revenue retention (GRR), net revenue retention (NRR), logo churn and renewal forecast accuracy , supported by health score coverage, product adoption, success plan coverage, NPS and the number of referenceable customers. What you will build and own: A global customer success model that scales. Clear segmentation and coverage, a clear owner and plan for every customer , and a shared definition of “great” at every stage of the lifecycle. A strong customer success leadership layer. Country leads, segment leads and CSMs with clear standards for account planning, customer reviews and renewal preparation, and the commercial judgement to apply them. A health and adoption framework that drives action. A shared view of customer health combining usage, engagement, support experience and sentiment, with scores that trigger action rather than sit in a dashboard . A retention and advocacy engine. Disciplined, predictable renewals with early engagement and evidence of value, and a pool of customers ready to share their success. How you will work: Hybrid, from our London, Kraków or Warsaw office, 3 days a week. In close, day-to-day collaboration with your direct reports, the Chief Customer Officer , and the Executive Leadership Team . In partnership with Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product . As the voice of the customer inside Singu , challenging constructively where something gets in the way of customer value. Balancing common global standards with what each market and customer group genuinely needs. What we are looking for Ideally, you can show the baseline you inherited, the changes you made and the measurable result that followed . Must have: Customer success leadership in a B2B SaaS business , with a track record of improving gross or net revenue retention and reducing churn . Experience leading customer success across countries , including leading through other leaders . Designed segmentation, coverage, lifecycle and health-scoring models that teams actually use. Practical experience of onboarding, driving product adoption and shortening time to value . Experience harmonising across countries, products or acquired businesses without over-standardising. Credibility with senior customer stakeholders and confidence leading executive business reviews . Ability to turn customer insight into a point of view and secure action from Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product. University degree level education. English at C1 level or above. Nice to have: Experience in proptech, real estate or facilities management . Track record of working in Private Equity backed software businesses . Polish or German language skills. Why join SINGU: Competitive salary based on your experience and location. The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing international SaaS company shaping the future of real estate operations. A role with real ownership and operational impact , where your work directly supports the efficiency of the entire organization. A collaborative and international environment , working with teams across multiple countries. The chance to improve and build processes in a scaling organization. A supportive culture built on adaptability, collaboration, and client focus . If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . Position Overview We're seeking a Manager, Business Risk and AI Automation, to help shape the next chapter of Internal Audit at Reddit. You'll lead day-to-day oversight and hands-on execution of our SOX program across Business Process Controls, Entity Level Controls, Key Reports, and Tech Application Controls, while helping build an AI-first approach to assurance. As part of our Risk Advisory and Assurance team, you'll tackle complex control questions and turn emerging technology into practical improvements. You’ll have opportunities to apply your expertise more broadly to strengthen internal controls and improve processes across the business. This is an opportunity for a strong internal controls practitioner who enjoys owning delivery and building better ways to work. This is an individual contributor role. The Manager owns SOX program delivery and partners with a Senior teammate who performs business process testing, providing review, technical guidance, and cross-functional coordination. What You’ll Do Own day-to-day SOX delivery from risk assessment and scoping through testing and reporting, keeping the program on track and focused on key risks. Lead walkthroughs and hands-on testing of control design and operating effectiveness across business process controls, entity level controls, key reports, and technology application controls. Ensure high-quality, well-supported SOX testing through workpaper review, actionable feedback, and technical guidance to other team members. Build trusted relationships across Finance and Accounting, Sales, People & Culture, Legal, and Technology to help control owners strengthen controls and improve processes while maintaining audit objectivity. Serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors, coordinating testing coverage, timelines, and evidence requirements to support our SOX reliance strategy. Evaluate testing exceptions, support deficiency assessment, and coordinate remediation tracking and retesting to confirm control issues are resolved. Help transform how SOX work gets done by identifying, piloting, and scaling AI and automation opportunities across evidence analysis, testing, documentation, and reporting. Build repeatable AI-enabled workflows, validate their accuracy, and help the team adopt them through clear documentation and coaching. A trusted partner who builds strong relationships with business stakeholders and external auditors, communicates findings constructively, and works through complex control judgments. Strong knowledge of SOX and COSO, including risk-based scoping, walkthroughs, control design and operating effectiveness testing, evidence evaluation, and deficiency assessment. Strong project management, workpaper review, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex processes and risks into clear conclusions and practical recommendations. title: Senior Data Analyst - Acquisition
description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience. By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards. HOW you will contribute to the company As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people). You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes. You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them. You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed. You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt). You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform. You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes. You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations. Within 3 months: You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers. You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT). You will contribute to larger cross-company projects. Within 6 months: You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap. You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform. You will share your learnings and best practices within the team. And beyond : the data team will continue growing with the company Which means: Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members Increased accountability in project leadership Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently. Who are we looking for? You’re the right candidate if you: Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years) Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly Are fluent in English (French is a plus) What does the recruitment process look like? A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min) A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min) An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min) What do we do to make your work life easier 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment 🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone. If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…) We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries. Who are we looking for ?
